tei:div.tei:p: "!#ྈ tshe sgrub lcags kyi bang mdzod sgrub thabs kun gyi yang snying bzhugs so: :

ྈྈྈྈྈྈྈྈ gzhom gzhig bral ba'i ye shes sku: 'od dpag med la phyag 'tshal lo: bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: mā ra tī ka'i brag phug tu: tshe yi rig 'dzin bsgrubs pa'i dus: tshe dpag yab yum dngos su byon: dbang bskur byin brlabs grub pa thob: skye 'chi med pa'i sku brnyes te: ma 'ongs 'gro la brtse phyir du: tshe sgrub brgya dang rtsa brgyad sbas: khyad par lcags kyi bang mdzod 'di: sgrub thabs kun gyi yang snying yin: 'di nyid sgrub pa'i rnal 'byor la: dus min 'chi ba mi 'byung ste: dus zad pa yi mi yin yang: lo gsum 'chi ba bzlog par 'gyur: sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya: nyams su blang ba'i rim pa ni: sgrub pa'i dkyil 'khor 'dzom na legs: tshom bu dag la brten kyang rung: gtor ma tshe bum ril bus bskor: gsang bum chang dang 'o mas gang: tshe mda' tshe dar tshe nas dang: mchod pa'i bye brag dpag med bsham: sngon du skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas: rang nyid lha yi nga rgyal gyis: bar chad bgegs la bka' bsgo ni: hūm̐: nga ni pad+ma he ru ka: nyon cig tshe yi bar chad bdud: gnas 'dir ma 'dug gzhan du dengs: gal te mi 'gro bgegs byed na: bdag nyid dpal gyi thugs ka nas: snang srid khro bo khro mos khengs: me rlung mtshon cha thog ser 'phro: log 'dren brlag par gdon mi za: oṃ shrī pad+ma kro dha ma hā bhai ra wa hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba bigh+nānaṃ uts+tsha ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa: gu gul bdug cing thun gyis brab: de nas mtshams bcad bya ba ni: hūm̐: bdag nyid drag po'i thugs ka nas: sprul pa'i khro bos snang srid khyab: phyogs mtshams thams cad mtshon chas bskor: me dpung rdo rje'i gur khang 'bar: oṃ shrī pad+ma kro dha ma hā bhai ra wa hūm̐ phaṭa: badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐: de nas yan lag bdun pa ni: hrī: nub phyogs bde chen zhing khams nas: 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs gshegs: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan la bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal:

phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul: nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags: bsod nams kun la yi rang ngo: chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul: mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs: dge rtsa 'gro drug yongs la bsngo: skye 'chi med pa'i lus thob shog: de nas byin dbab bya ba ni: hrī: mi mngon dbyings kyi zhing khams nas: 'chi med tshe yi lha tshogs rnams: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang skur cig: oṃ āḥhūm̐ a mi de wa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa mā dzaḥpra be sha ya a ā: de nas mchod pa byin rlabs ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: 'dir bshams zag med mchod pa'i sprin: rab 'byams nam mkha'i mtha' mnyam ni: 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan: ye shes bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ha ho hrī: oṃ bh+rūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: pañca a mṛta rak+ta bha liṃ ta hūm̐ hrīḥthā: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐: puṣ+pe= dhū pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= nai wid+ya= shab+da āḥhūm̐: de nas ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni: oṃ āḥhūm̐: smra bsam brjod 'das de bzhin nyid: dbyings dang ye shes gnyis su med: rang rig ma 'gags yi ge hrī: bde stong zung 'jug nyams rtsal 'bar: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ: dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ: hrīḥtsit+ta badz+ra sa mā ti hūm̐: de nas gzhal yas lha bskyed ni: bdag mdun dbyer med 'di ltar bsgom: hrī: g.yo med chos sku'i mkha' dbyings su: 'khrul med bde stong dkyil 'khor shar: sra zhing mkhregs pa las grub pa'i: rdo rje rgya gram lte ba ru: 'od lnga'i rang mdangs gzhal yas khang: pho brang phyi nang mtshan nyid rdzogs: gru chad bar khyams sgo khyud mdzes: pad 'dab phyi nang thams cad kyang: dkar ser dmar ljang 'od du 'bar: 'khor yug rdo rje'i ra bas bskor: phyi nang sgrib med 'ja' 'od klong: dbus su rma bya bsnol ba'i steng: lcags kyi pad+ma sra zhing brtan:

tsha grang 'od 'bar brtsegs pa'i khrir: hrīḥyig dmar po'i 'phro 'du las: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: sku mdog pad+ma rā ga'i mdog: zhal gcig phyag gnyis longs spyod rdzogs: mtshan dang dpe byad rgyan gyis mdzes: phyag gnyis mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin: zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: spyan dkyus ring zhing zhal bzhad 'dzum: dbu skra thor tshug bcings lhag grol: dar dang rin chen sna tshogs brgyan: ba spu'i bu ga thams cad na: longs sku'i zhing khams re re gnas: 'ja' 'od thig le thig phran dbus: tshe bsod rgyas pa'i tshul du gsal: gos dkar mo dang dbyer med 'khril: hrī: bcom ldan mgon po'i mdun phyogs g.yas: pad+ma ge sar gdan steng du: rig 'dzin pad+ma tshe dpag med: dkar gsal mda' dar tshe bum bsnams: rgyan dang cha lugs gtso dang mtshungs: man+dā ra dang dbyer med 'khril: sku las 'od zer dkar po 'phros: 'byung ba'i bcud dang skye 'gro'i tshe: thams cad sdud pa'i tshul du gsal: hrī: bcom ldan mgon po'i mdun phyogs g.yon: shing lo 'bras bu rgyas pa'i dbus: mkha' 'gro tshe bdag dkar mo ni: zhal gcig phyag gnyis tshe bum bsnams: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: zhabs gnyis bzhengs pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs: sku las 'od zer sngon po 'phro: tshe la dbang ba thams cad kyis: mthu stobs byin rlabs sdud par byed: hrī: dkyil 'khor tshom bu'i shar phyogs su: bcom ldan rdo rje tshe dpag med: sku mdog dkar po longs spyod rdzogs: rdo rje g.yas la tshe bum g.yon: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: skyil krung sangs rgyas spyan ma 'khril: me long ye shes rang mdangs las: zhe sdang 'joms pa'i tshul du gsal: hrī: dkyil 'khor tshom bu'i lho phyogs su: bcom ldan rin chen tshe dpag med: sku mdog ser po longs spyod rdzogs: rin chen g.yas la tshe bum g.yon: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes:

skyil krung mā ma kī dang sbyor: mnyam nyid ye shes rang mdangs las: nga rgyal 'joms pa'i tshul du gsal: hrī: dkyil 'khor tshom bu'i nub phyogs su: bcom ldan pad+ma tshe dpag med: sku mdog dmar po longs spyod rdzogs: pad+ma g.yas la tshe bum g.yon: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: skyil krung pad+ma mkha' 'gro 'khril: sor rtog ye shes rang mdangs las: 'dod chags 'joms pa'i tshul du gsal: hrī: dkyil 'khor tshom bu'i byang phyogs su: bcom ldan karma tshe dpag med: sku mdog ljang khu longs spyod rdzogs: rgya gram g.yas la tshe bum g.yon: dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes: skyil krung dam tshig sgrol dang 'khril: bya grub ye shes rang mdangs las: phrag dog 'joms pa'i tshul du gsal: de yi phyi rim 'dab brgyad la: shar du rdo rje tshe bdag mo: sku mdog dkar mo shel bum bsnams: lho ru rin chen tshe bdag mo: sku mdog ser mo gser bum bsnams: nub tu pad+ma tshe bdag mo: sku mdog dmar mo zangs bum bsnams: byang du las kyi tshe bdag mo: sku mdog ljang mo g.yu bum bsnams: kun kyang dar dang rin chen brgyan: sgeg cing chags pa'i nyams dang ldan: zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung bzhugs: shar lhor rdo rje mgyogs ma dkar: mda' dar rdo rje lcags kyu 'dzin: lho nub rin chen mgyogs ma ser: mda' dar rin chen zhags pa 'dzin: nub byang pad+ma'i mgyogs ma dmar: mda' dar pad+ma lcags sgrog 'dzin: byang shar las kyi mgyogs ma ljang: mda' dar rgya gram dril bu 'dzin: kun kyang dar dang rin chen brgyan: me tog sna tshogs do shal 'phyang: zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum gar gyis bzhugs: rang rang sprul pa khri 'bum 'phro: shar sgor rdo rje lcags kyu dkar: khro bo'i chas rdzogs 'gugs byed bsnams: rdo rje mkha' 'gro sku la 'khril: gyad kyi dor stabs tshul du bzhugs: lho sgor rin chen zhags pa ser: khro bo'i chas rdzogs 'ching byed bsnams:

rin chen mkha' 'gro sku la 'khril: gyad kyi 'dor stabs tshul du bzhugs: nub sgor pad+ma lcags sgrog dmar: khro bo'i chas rdzogs sdom byed bsnams: pad+ma mkha' 'gro sku la 'khril: gyad kyi 'dor stabs tshul du bzhugs: byang sgor las byed dril bu ljang: khro bo'i chas rdzogs myos byed bsnams: las kyi mkha' 'gro sku la 'khril: gyad kyi 'dor stabs tshul du bzhugs: phyi rim 'khor yug chen po la: rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las: tshe bdag pho mo thams cad dang: tshe la dbang ba'i rig 'dzin tshogs: dpag med nam mkha'i sprin ltar gtibs: ma 'dres yongs rdzogs dkyil 'khor lha: me long nang gi gzugs brnyan bzhin: stong gsal ngang du gnas par gyur: oṃ bh+rūm̐ ā yuḥhūm̐ nṛ dza: oṃ āḥhūm̐: a mi de wa sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: de nas spyan 'dren bya ba ni: lha rdzas la sogs dri bzang bsreg: mda' dar g.yab cing rol mo sgrog: gdung ba drag pos 'di skad do: hrī: phyogs bcu'i mu med zhing khams nas: rgyal ba rgya mtsho sku bzhengs shig: rang bzhin rnam dag zhing khams nas: zhi khro rab 'byams sku bzhengs shig: o rgyan mkha' spyod zhing khams nas: ma rgyud mkha' 'gro sku bzhengs shig: spyi gtsug pad zla'i gdan steng nas: rtsa ba'i bla ma sku bzhengs shig: dur khrod chen po'i gnas brgyad nas: ma mgon lcam dral sku bzhengs shig: gnas dang yul gyi zhing khams nas: zhing skyong pho mo sku bzhengs shig: gnas mchog 'di ru byin phob la: sgrub mchog bdag la dbang bzhi skur: bgegs dang log 'dren bar chad sol: mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol: hrī: nub phyogs bde chen dag pa'i zhing: pad+ma 'bar ba'i nags tshal nas: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: gos dkar mo yi yum dang bcas: tshe dbang rig 'dzin thams cad dang: pad+ma rigs kyi 'khor gyis bskor: gdung ba drags pos spyan 'dren na: thugs rje'i dbang gis gshegs su gsol:

hrī: rnga yab za byed srin po'i yul: 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khyim nas: rig 'dzin pad+ma tshe dpag med: man+dā ra ba yum dang bcas: dpa' bo mkha' 'gro grangs med dang: rig 'dzin grub thob rgya mtshos bskor: gdung ba drags pos spyan 'dren na: thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol: hrī: brag phug mā ra ti ka'i gnas: me tog shing lo rgyas pa'i dbus: mkha' 'gro tshe bdag dkar mo ni: tshe la dbang ba'i lha mor bcas: gnas gsum mkha' 'gro mang po dang: grub pa'i lha mo rnams kyis bskor: gdung ba drags pos spyan 'dren na: thugs dam dbang gis gshegs su gsol: hrī: shar phyogs mngon dga'i zhing khams nas: rdo rje tshe dpag gshegs su gsol: lho phyogs dpal mdzes zhing khams nas: rin chen tshe dpag gshegs su gsol: nub phyogs bde chen zhing khams nas: pad+ma tshe dpag gshegs su gsol: byang phyogs las rdzogs zhing khams nas: karma tshe dpag gshegs su gsol: phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad dkyil 'khor nas: tshe bdag bzhi dang mgyogs ma bzhi: sgo ba sgo ma rig 'dzin tshogs: yab yum sprul pa yang sprul bcas: tshe la dbang ba thams cad kun: gdung ba drags pos spyan 'dren na: thugs dam dbang gis gshegs nas kyang: byin chen phob la dbang chen skur: ye shes pa dang dam tshig pa: chu la chu bzhag ji bzhin du: lhan cig 'dres pa'i ngo bo ni: bde ba chen por e ma ho: de nas bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hrī: pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du: 'gyur med tshe lha'i lha tshogs rnams: dgyes shing brtan par bzhugs nas kyang: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: oṃ āḥhūm̐: a mi de wa sa pa ri wā ra sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan: gus pas lha phyag 'tshal ba ni: e ma ho: rdo rje lta bu'i sku brnyes nas: tshe yi dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i: skye 'chi med pa'i lha tshogs la: zhing gi rdul snyed sprul phyag 'tshal: a mi de wa sa pa ri wā ra a ti pū ho pra ti dza ho:

de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni: ho: mchod yon me tog bdug spos me: dri mchog zhal zas rol mo dbyangs: 'chi med rdo rje'i lha tshogs la: gus pas 'bul lo 'chi med stsol: ar+ghaṃ puṣ+pe dhū pe ā lo ke gan+dhe nai wid+ya shab+da pū tsa haṃ: ho: mdzes snyan dri bzang mngar ba'i ro: reg 'jam mchog gi dga' ba che: 'chi med rdo rje'i lha tshogs la: gus pas 'bul lo 'chi med stsol: rū pa shab+da gan+dhe ra sa spar+she pū dza āḥhūm̐: ho: thabs shes zung 'jug gnyis med sbyor: 'khor 'das ro gcig ngang du bsgral: 'chi med rdo rje'i lha tshogs la: gus pas 'bul lo 'chi med stsol: bo dhi tsit+ta ga ṇa gu h+ya pū tsa ho: ho: 'chi med sman dang chags pa'i khrag: brjid ldan gtor ma ri ltar spungs: 'chi med rdo rje'i lha tshogs la: gus pas 'bul lo 'chi med stsol: pañca a mṛta rak+ta ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi: de nas bstod pa bya ba ni: hūm̐ hrī: bde bar gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das: 'gro ba'i mgon po 'od dpag med: thugs rje chen po'i rjes chags mdzad: skyob pa mtshungs med khyod la bstod: hrī: skye 'chi med pa ye shes lus: mtshan dpes rab brgyan bye ru'i mdangs: bgres rgud mi mnga' gzhon tshul ldan: rdo rje'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: ma 'gags thabs spyod bdud rtsi'i sgra: yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan zhing: 'chal tshig mi mnga' yid 'ong tshig: rdo rje'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: mtha' dbus med pa chos kyi dbyings: shes bya sna tshogs ji bzhin mkhyen: spros pa mi mnga' bde stong rgyun: rdo rje'i thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod: hrī: nam mkha'i mdzod 'dzin ye shes che: bde legs phun tshogs dngos grub ster: 'khrul pa mi mnga' lhun gyis grub: yon tan rab rdzogs khyod la bstod: hrī: gang la gang 'dul der ston zhing: rnam pa bzhi yis 'gro kun 'dul: skyo ngal mi mnga' thugs rje'i bdag:

phrin las rab rdzogs khyod la bstod: hrī: dmar gsal mnyam gzhag tshe bum 'dzin: longs spyod rdzogs pa'i cha lugs can: dar dang rin chen mdzes pas spras: gzi brjid rgyal po'i sku la bstod: gsang ba'i yum mchog gos dkar mo: dmar ser gzhon tshul bde ba rgyas: mda' dar tshe bum yab la 'khril: dbang mo tshe bdag khyod la bstod: hrī: dkar gsal mda' dar tshe bum 'dzin: longs sku dar dang rin chen brgyan: mngal skyes ma gos lhun gyis grub: bstan pa'i sgron me khyod la bstod: gsang ba'i yum mchog man+dā ra: mu tig mdangs mtshungs yab la 'khril: lcags phur tshe bum phyag na bsnams: spyi dpal ḍā ki khyod la bstod: hrī: sgyu ma lta bu'i ting 'dzin brnyes: chu shel mdangs mtshungs tshe bum 'dzin: grub pa'i lha mo kun gyi gtso: tshe bdag dkar mo khyod la bstod: hrī: me long ye shes rnam par dag: rdo rje tshe yi dngos grub brnyes: dung mdog rtse lnga tshe bum 'dzin: thugs mchog rdo rje khyod la bstod: gsang ba'i yum mchog sangs rgyas spyan: dkar mo gzhon tshul tshe bum 'dzin: bde ba chen pos yab la 'khril: sa khams rnam dag khyod la bstod: hrī: mnyam nyid ye shes rnam par dag: rig 'dzin tshe yi dngos grub brnyes: gser mdog nor bu'i tshe bum 'dzin: yon tan rdo rje khyod la bstod: gsang ba'i yum mchog mā ma kī: sngon mo gzhon tshul tshe bum 'dzin: bde ba chen pos yab la 'khril: chu khams rnam dag khyod la bstod: hrī: sor rtog ye shes rnam par dag: pad+ma tshe yi dngos grub brnyes: zangs mdog me tog tshe bum 'dzin: gsung mchog rdo rje khyod la bstod: yum mchog pad+ma mkha' 'gro ni: dmar mo gzhon tshul tshe bum 'dzin: bde ba chen pos yab la 'khril: me khams rnam dag khyod la bstod: hrī: bya ba grub pa'i ye shes sku: phrin las tshe yi dngos grub brnyes: g.yu mdog rgya gram tshe bum 'dzin: karma rdo rje khyod la bstod:

gsang ba'i yum mchog dam tshig sgrol: ljang mo gzhon tshul tshe bum 'dzin: bde ba chen pos yab la 'khril: rlung khams rnam dag khyod la bstod: hrī: tshe bdag dkar mo shel bum bsnams: 'byung ba chu bcud sdud mdzad ma: khrag gi khams la stsol mdzad ma: rdo rje gsang ba'i yum la bstod: hrī: tshe bdag ser mo gser bum bsnams: 'byung ba sa bcud sdud mdzad ma: sha yi khams la stsol mdzad ma: rin chen gsang ba'i yum la bstod: hrī: tshe bdag dmar mo zangs bum bsnams: 'byung ba me bcud sdud mdzad ma: drod kyi khams la stsol mdzad ma: pad+ma gsang ba'i yum la bstod: hrī: tshe bdag ljang mo g.yu bum bsnams: 'byung ba rlung bcud sdud mdzad ma: dbugs kyi khams la stsol mdzad ma: karma gsang ba'i yum la bstod: hrī: pho nya dkar mo gzi brjid can: mda' dar lcags kyus dri za sdud: tshe yi dngos grub gnad nas 'gugs: rdo rje mgyogs ma khyod la bstod: hrī: pho nya ser mo gzi brjid can: mda' dar zhags pas gshin rje sdud: tshe yi dngos grub gnad nas 'gugs: rin chen mgyogs ma khyod la bstod: hrī: pho nya dmar mo gzi brjid can: mda' dar lcags sgrog chu lha sdud: tshe yi dngos grub gnad nas 'gugs: pad+ma'i mgyogs ma khyod la bstod: hrī: pho nya ljang mo gzi brjid can: mda' dar dril bus gnod sbyin sdud: tshe yi dngos grub gnad nas 'gugs: las kyi mgyogs ma khyod la bstod: hrī: dkyil 'khor shar sgo srung mdzad pa: lcags kyu dang ni lcags kyu ma: khros pa'i cha lugs 'gugs byed bsnams: lha bdud 'joms mdzad khyod la bstod: hrī: dkyil 'khor lho sgo srung mdzad pa: zhags pa dang ni zhags pa ma: khros pa'i cha lugs 'ching byed bsnams: 'chi bdag bdud 'joms khyod la bstod: hrī: dkyil 'khor nub sgo srung mdzad pa: lcags sgrog dang ni lcags sgrog ma: khros pa'i cha lugs sdom byed bsnams: nyon mongs bdud 'joms khyod la bstod:

hrī: dkyil 'khor byang sgo srung mdzad pa: dril bu dang ni dril bu ma: khros pa'i cha lugs myos byed bsnams: phung po'i bdud 'joms khyod la bstod: gzhan yang drang srong rig 'dzin tshogs: tshe la dbang ba thams cad kun: rgyan dang cha lugs sna tshogs 'chang: tshe bdag pho mo khyod la bstod:

(brum̐) de nas bshags pa bya ba ni: ho: dgongs shig rdo rje tshe yi lha: bdag cag ma rig dbang gyur pas: bskal pa sngon nas da lta'i bar: 'gal 'khrul nyams chag ci bgyis bshags: yi ge brgya pa brjod: de nas dzap la 'jug pa ni: tshe lha rnams kyi thugs ka ru: pad+ma 'dab brgyad lte ba la: rdo rje nas 'bras tsam gyi dbus: nyi zla yungs 'bru phyed gshag steng: pho rgyud rnams la yi ge hrī: mo rgyud rnams la yi ge ā: ba spus bris pa lta bu'i mthar: sngags phreng bskor ba lu gu rgyud: me long nang gi gzugs ltar gsal: de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros: rgyal ba zhi khro rab 'byams dang: tshe lha drang srong rig 'dzin sogs: tshe la dbang ba thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang: bkrag mdangs gzi brjid mthu stobs kun: 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par bsdus: rang gi gnas lngar thim par bsam: slar yang 'od zer mthing ga 'phros: 'byung ba nam mkha'i bcud rnams bsdus: yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam par gyur: rang gi sems la thim par bsam: 'od zer ser po phyogs bcur 'phros: 'byung ba sa yi bcud rnams bsdus: yi ge laṃ gyi rnam par gyur: rang gi sha la thim par bsam: 'od zer dkar po phyogs bcur 'phros: 'byung ba chu yi bcud rnams bsdus: yi ge baṃ gyi rnam par gyur: rang gi khrag la thim par bsam: 'od zer dmar po phyogs bcur 'phros: 'byung ba me yi bcud rnams bsdus: yi ge raṃ gyi rnam par gyur: rang gi drod la thim par bsam: 'od zer ljang gu phyogs bcur 'phros: 'byung ba rlung gi bcud rnams bsdus: yi ge yaṃ gyi rnam par gyur: rang gi dbugs la thim par bsam: slar yang 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros: 'khor mang drag rtsal stobs ldan sogs: tshe bsod can rnams thams cad dang: skye 'gro sems can kun la phog: tshe bsod dpal 'byor dbang thang bsdus: yi ge nṛ yi rnam par gyur: rang gi snying la thim par

bsam: 'od zer dkar ser dmar ljang dang: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ'i yi ge 'phros: tshe srog gdon gyis khyer ba rnams: 'od kyis rang dbang med par bkug: 'chi med bdud rtsi'i rnam par gyur: spyi bo'i gtsug nas mar la thim: rang gi lus rnams mer gyis khengs: 'chi med srog rtsa 'grub par bsam: rang nyid tshe dpag gsal ba yi: srog rtsa lcags las grub pa dang: lcags kyi pad 'dab 'brel bar dmigs: yi ge kaṃ la rig pa gtad: srog gcod spangs la sngags 'di bzla: oṃ a mā ra ṇi dzī wan+ti swā hā: zhes dang: oṃ bh+rūm̐ ā yuḥhūm̐ nṛ dza:oṃ hrīḥpad+ma dha ra ā yuḥsid+dhi dza: oṃ ma hā gu ru pad+mā ka ra ā yur+dz+nyā na puṇ+ye sid+dhi dzaḥhūm̐ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra bh+rūm̐: hrī:ḍā ki nī ā yur+dz+nyā na hūm̐ bh+rūm̐: oṃ ak+ṣo bh+ya badz+ra ā yuḥsid+dhi hūm̐: oṃ rat+na saṃ bha wa ā yuḥsid+dhi trāṃ: oṃ pad+ma dha ra ā yuḥsid+dhi hrī: oṃ a mo gha karma ā yuḥsid+dhi ā: oṃ de wī ha ri ni sa ā yur+dz+nyā na puṇ+ye sid+dhi dza: nṛ bh+rūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: rtsa sngags bye ba grangs dang sbyar: gzhan rnams skabs dang bstun cing bzla: sgrub cing nyams su blangs gyur na: dus min 'chi ba bzlog par nges: tshe zad yin yang lo gsum thar: mi lo bcu gnyis bsgrubs gyur na: 'chi med 'grub par the tshom med: lcags kyi srog rtsa 'grub pa yin: gnas skabs bsgrubs pa'i 'grub rtags ni: sna bug g.yas nas dbugs mi rgyu: rmi lam lcags kyi rdo rje mthong: lus la go khrab gyon pa dang: chu chen brgal dang g.yang las thar: seṅge zhon dang nyi zla bzung: lcags kyi khang par 'dug pa sogs: 'grub rtags yin pas dus min gyi: 'chi ba bzlog par the tshom med: srog gcod spang ba dam tshig yin: sa ma ya rgya rgya rgya: gnyis pa tshe 'gugs byed pa ni: mched dang lcam dral thams cad 'dus: spos dang dri bzang shing rnams bsreg: dbyangs snyan rol mo'i sgra yis bskul:

mda' dar g.yab cing 'di skad do: hrī: bcom ldan mgon po tshe dpag med: gsang ba'i yum mchog gos dkar mo: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: bla tshe srog tshe dbugs tshe sogs: nyams pa thams cad 'gugs par mdzod: 'byung ba'i bcud dang skye 'gro'i tshe: ma lus bdag la gnang du gsol: srog gi khams nas tshe nyams na: nam mkha'i khams nas bcud bsdus te: 'od zer mthing kha'i tshul du stsol: 'khor lo hūm̐ gis rgyas thob cig: hrī: pad+ma 'byung gnas tshe dpag med: man+dā ra ba yum dang bcas: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: bla tshe srog tshe dbugs tshe sogs: nyams pa thams cad 'gugs par mdzod: 'byung ba'i bcud dang skye 'gro'i tshe: ma lus bdag la gnang du gsol: hrī: lha mo tshe bdag dkar mo ni: grub pa'i lha mo rnams dang bcas: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: bla tshe srog tshe dbugs tshe sogs: nyams pa thams cad 'gugs par mdzod: 'byung ba'i bcud dang skye 'gro'i tshe: ma lus bdag la gnang du gsol: hrī: bcom ldan rdo rje tshe dpag med: sangs rgyas spyan ma yum dang bcas: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: bla tshe srog tshe dbugs tshe sogs: nyams pa thams cad 'gugs par mdzod: 'byung ba'i bcud dang skye 'gro'i tshe: ma lus bdag la gnang du gsol: khrag gi khams nas tshe nyams na: chu yi khams nas bcud bsdus te: 'od zer dkar po'i tshul du stsol: rdo rje hrīḥyis rgyas thob cig: hrī: bcom ldan rin chen tshe dpag med: yum chen mā ma kī dang bcas: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: bla tshe srog tshe dbugs tshe sogs: nyams pa thams cad 'gugs par mdzod: 'byung ba'i bcud dang skye 'gro'i tshe: ma lus bdag la gnang du gsol: sha yi khams nas tshe nyams na:

sa yi khams nas bcud bsdus te: 'od zer ser po'i tshul du stsol: rin chen swā yis rgyas thob cig: hrī: bcom ldan pad+ma tshe dpag med: pad+ma mkha' 'gro yum dang bcas: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: bla tshe srog tshe dbugs tshe sogs: nyams pa thams cad 'gugs par mdzod: 'byung ba'i bcud dang skye 'gro'i tshe: ma lus bdag la gnang du gsol: drod kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: me yi khams nas bcud bsdus te: 'od zer dmar po'i tshul du stsol: pad+ma āḥyis rgyas thob cig: hrī: bcom ldan karma tshe dpag med: dam tshig sgrol ma yum dang bcas: khyed kyi thugs dam dus la bab: 'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol: bla tshe srog tshe dbugs tshe sogs: nyams pa thams cad 'gugs par mdzod: 'byung ba'i bcud dang skye 'gro'i tshe: ma lus bdag la gnang du gsol: dbugs kyi khams nas tshe nyams na: rlung gi khams nas bcud bsdus te: 'od zer ljang gu'i tshul du stsol: rgya gram hā yis rgyas thob cig: hrī: shar gyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: dkar mo tshe bdag dus la bab: shel bum rdo rje tshe yis bkang: spyi bo'i gtsug nas dbang skur cig: bla srog tshe bsod ma lus kun: yar ba khug la nyams pa gsos: gas pa sbyor la chad pa mthud: rdo rje rigs kyi tshe khug cig: hrī: lho yi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: ser mo tshe bdag dus la bab: gser bum rdo rje tshe yis bkang: spyi bo'i gtsug nas dbang skur cig: bla srog tshe bsod ma lus kun: yar ba khug la nyams pa gsos: gas pa sbyor la chad pa mthud: rin chen rigs kyi tshe khug cig: hrī: nub kyi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: dmar mo tshe bdag dus la bab: zangs bum rdo rje tshe yis bkang: spyi bo'i gtsug nas dbang skur cig: bla srog tshe bsod ma lus kun: yar ba khug la nyams pa gsos: gas pa sbyor la chad pa mthud: pad+ma rigs kyi tshe khug cig: hrī:

byang gi phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: ljang mo tshe bdag dus la bab: g.yu bum rdo rje tshe yis bkang: spyi bo'i gtsug nas dbang skur cig: bla srog tshe bsod ma lus kun: yar ba khug la nyams pa gsos: gas pa sbyor la chad pa mthud: karma rigs kyi tshe khug cig: hrī: shar lho'i phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: rdo rje mgyogs ma'i dus la bab: tshe mda' g.yas la lcags kyu g.yon: rgyal rigs tshe bsod dbang thang dang: dri zas phrogs pa'i tshe khug la: rnal 'byor bdag la bstsal nas kyang: mi 'gyur rdo rje'i rgyas thob cig: hrī: lho nub phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: rin chen mgyogs ma'i dus la bab: tshe mda' g.yas la zhags pa g.yon: rje'u rigs tshe bsod dbang thang dang: gshin rjes phrogs pa'i tshe khug la: rnal 'byor bdag la bstsal nas kyang: bsam 'phel nor bu'i rgyas thob cig: hrī: nub byang phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: pad+ma mgyogs ma'i dus la bab: tshe mda' g.yas la lcags sgrog g.yon: bram ze'i tshe bsod dbang thang dang: klu yis phrogs pa'i tshe khug la: rnal 'byor bdag la bstsal nas kyang: ma chags pad+ma'i rgyas thob cig: hrī: byang shar phyogs nas tshe 'gugs ma: las kyi mgyogs ma'i dus la bab: tshe mda' g.yas la dril bu g.yon: dmangs rigs tshe bsod dbang thang dang: gnod sbyin phrogs pa'i tshe khug la: rnal 'byor bdag la bstsal nas kyang: lhun grub rgya gram rgyas thob cig: hrī: tshe bcud srog bcud 'byung ba'i bcud: yi ge nṛ yig rnam par sdus: rang gi gnas lngar gnyis med thim: phyag rgya bdun gyis rgyas btab bo: dharma dhā tu mū dra hūm̐ hūm̐: pra dz+nyā u pa mu dra hūm̐ hūm̐: karma kā ya wā ka tsit+ta mu dra hūm̐ hūm̐: dz+nyā na tsa tur mu dra hūm̐ hūm̐: bud+dha pañca mu dra hūm̐ hūm̐: ta kṛta h+ya gh+rī wa mu dra hūm̐ hūm̐: badz+ra mu dra hūm̐ hūm̐: oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā: zhes brjod cing me tog 'thor: lus la rdo rje'i go khrab gyon nas 'od 'khyil bar

bsam: hrī: dang po chos kyi dbyings kyi rgya: gnyis pa thabs dang shes rab rgya: gsum pa sku gsung thugs kyi rgya: bzhi pa ye shes bzhi yi rgya: lnga pa sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i rgya: drug pa dbang chen rta mgrin rgya: bdun pa 'gyur med rdo rje'i rgya: phyag rgya bdun gyi rgyas gdab bo: ྈ gtor ma rang gi spyi bor bzhag: tshe zan brten cing tshe chang btung: rjes chog bla ma'i gzhung du gsal: ma 'ongs skyes bu dad ldan rnams: pad 'byung tshad mar 'dzin pa dang: 'chi med rig 'dzin bsgrub 'dod na: tshe sgrub 'di la 'bad par rigs: sa ma yā rgya rgya rgya: bka' 'di rā hu la yis srungs: dus bab las can bu la sprod: rak+sha rā hu la sa ma ya ha na ha na rak+ṣa rak+ṣa: kho bo rol pa'i rdo rjes gter nas spyan drangs pa'o// //
